title: Measure usefulness on real tasks
summary: LLM evaluation should use examples of the intended job. Check correctness, missing information, format and difficult cases with the same rules each time.
introduction: LLM evaluation should use examples of the intended job. Check correctness, missing information, format and difficult cases with the same rules each time. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain measure usefulness on real tasks
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: LLM evaluation should use examples of the intended job. Check correctness, missing information, format and difficult cases with the same rules each time.

blocks.code:
Task: answer from club notices
Case A: room is clearly given
Case B: room is missing
Case C: two notices conflict
Check: supported answer or a clear statement of uncertainty
blocks.title: Measure usefulness on real tasks

blocks.text: The cases include easy answers and reasons to avoid guessing. A model that invents a room in case B fails even if its sentence is well written.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write the expected behaviour for conflicting notices.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not judge a model only by one impressive response.
For more detail later, use this [Large Language Models further reading](https://huggingface.co/learn/llm-course/chapter1/1).

seo.title: Language Models: Measure usefulness on real tasks
